I made the game private since I no longer wish to associate myself with them, their games, or their community. If you think this game doesn't exist, click here for proof

5.project-description: A remake of Clockwork's "Dodge the Teapots of Doom" (originally released December 15, 2007). Teapot Tumble expands the concept with a shop system, in-game currency, a speedrun timer, and a procedurally generated map that increases in difficulty as more players win.

6.project-description: Race against the clock in Same Day Shipping, a fast-paced multiplayer roguelike where every second counts as you rush to deliver packages before time runs out!

7.project-description: Welcome to Class Warfare, a free-for-all fighting game where you battle using different morphs called classes. Each class uses Roblox gear from the catalog.
